title: 2021 JESUS SANCHEZ - TOPPS INCEPTION GREEN PARALLEL ROOKIE #22 RC MARLINS
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare 2021 Topps Inception baseball trading card featuring Jesus Sanchez, a rookie player for the Florida Marlins. The card is a short print and has a green parallel variety, making it a highly sought-after item for collectors. 

The card is from the 2021 Topps Inception set and is numbered 22. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is sure to impress fans of the Major League Baseball. Don't miss out on the chance to own this unique and valuable card.
